name: Basic Zombie
description: Basic zombie; moves and eats plants.
flavor: Shambles forward and eats whatever green thing is nearest. He hates the word "basic" and insists he is going places.

name: Conehead Zombie
description: Conehead zombie; has a cone armor that absorbs damage before health is affected.
flavor: A traffic cone doubles his staying power. He found it on the road and has never once considered giving it back.

name: Buckethead Zombie
description: Buckethead zombie; stronger armor than Conehead.
flavor: The bucket turns him into a walking dent magnet. He cannot see a thing and considers this a fair trade.

name: Brickhead Zombie
description: Brickhead zombie; even tougher armor.
flavor: Wears an actual screen door's worth of masonry on his head. Peas simply give up on contact.

name: Gargantuar
description: Huge zombie; smashes plants instantly and throws an Imp when damaged or near the house.
flavor: Enormous, unhurried, and carrying a telephone pole. He does not eat plants so much as file them under "gone".

name: Imp
description: Small, fast zombie thrown by Gargantuar; runs after landing.
flavor: Small, quick, and airborne against his will. He lands running because stopping was never an option.

name: Flag Zombie
description: Flag zombie; same as basic but used to mark wave starts.
flavor: Carries the banner that says the wave has started. Nobody elected him; he simply picked up the flag and kept walking.

name: Mummy Zombie
description: Basic Egyptian zombie.
flavor: Wrapped, dusty, and four thousand years late for lunch. The bandages are less armour and more a lifestyle.

name: Conehead Mummy
description: Conehead Egyptian zombie.
flavor: An ancient cone over ancient wrappings. Archaeologists are still arguing about which came first.

name: Buckethead Mummy
description: Buckethead Egyptian zombie.
flavor: The bucket predates the wheel and outlasts most peashooters. He is very proud of both facts.

name: Brickhead Mummy
description: Brickhead Egyptian zombie.
flavor: Stone headgear quarried from a pyramid nobody was using. Extremely heavy, extremely effective.

name: Pharaoh Zombie
description: Walks slowly inside a sarcophagus; after it breaks, the zombie runs faster.
flavor: Rides inside a sarcophagus until it cracks open, then discovers he is much faster without a coffin strapped to him.

name: Ra Zombie
description: Steals sun from the player’s reserve.
flavor: Steals sun straight out of your reserve with a golden staff. He insists it is a tax, not theft.

name: Explorer Zombie
description: Carries a torch that instantly destroys specific plants (e.g., Frost Bonnet).
flavor: Carries a torch that turns delicate plants into cinders on contact. He has never once read a fire safety notice.

name: Tomb Raiser Zombie
description: Summons graves (tombs) on the lawn.
flavor: Summons gravestones out of bare lawn. Where he gets them is a question nobody wants answered.

name: Camel Zombie
description: Three-segment camel zombie; only the front segment eats, rear segments follow.
flavor: Three zombies in one camel costume. Only the front one eats; the back two are there for moral support.

name: Egypt Gargantuar
description: Egyptian Gargantuar; smashes plants and throws an Egyptian Imp.
flavor: A Gargantuar with a sarcophagus lid for a club. He throws an equally bandaged Imp when the mood takes him.

name: Egypt Imp
description: Imp thrown by Egyptian Gargantuar.
flavor: A tiny mummy launched at speed. He has no plan beyond landing and running.

name: Cave Zombie
description: Basic ice-age zombie.
flavor: Frozen solid for millennia and still grumpy about the thaw. Fire barely improves his mood.

name: Conehead Cave Zombie
description: Conehead ice-age zombie.
flavor: A cone that has been iced over so long it counts as geology. Chips rather than dents.

name: Buckethead Cave Zombie
description: Buckethead ice-age zombie.
flavor: The bucket froze to his head some centuries ago. Removing it is no longer on the table.

name: Blockhead Zombie
description: Wears an ice block as armor; the block also chills plants that attack it.
flavor: Wears a solid block of ice as a helmet, and the block chills whatever hits it. Attacking him is its own punishment.

name: Hunter Zombie
description: Ranged zombie; throws snowballs that chill or freeze plants from a distance.
flavor: Lobs snowballs from well out of reach, freezing plants where they stand. He has excellent aim and no sense of fair play.

name: Troglobite
description: Pushes ice blocks down the lane; blocks crush plants and absorb damage.
flavor: Shoves a block of ice down the lane, flattening anything under it. The block does the work; he takes the credit.

name: Dodo Rider Zombie
description: Flies over certain plants and obstacles.
flavor: Rides a dodo clean over your defences. The dodo is extinct and appears entirely unbothered by this.

name: Weasel Hoarder
description: When damaged, releases fast, weak weasels (similar to chickens).
flavor: Hoards weasels. When struck, the weasels leave in a hurry and in all directions at once.

name: Weasel
description: The small, fast weasel unit.
flavor: Fast, small, and extremely committed. He was hoarded against his will and intends to make it everyone's problem.

name: Ice Age Gargantuar
description: Gargantuar of Frostbite Caves; throws an ice-age Imp.
flavor: A Gargantuar in a fur coat swinging a frozen mammoth leg. Winter has not slowed him down in the slightest.

name: Ice Age Imp
description: Imp thrown by ice-age Gargantuar.
flavor: A tiny zombie in a very large parka, thrown a very long way.

name: Pompadour Zombie
description: Basic beach zombie.
flavor: Perfect hair, ruined complexion. He came for the surf and stayed for the brains.

name: Conehead Pompadour
description: Conehead beach zombie.
flavor: A cone on a pompadour. He believes the silhouette works and nobody has the heart to correct him.

name: Buckethead Pompadour
description: Buckethead beach zombie.
flavor: A bucket over the hairstyle. Hours of work, gone, and he is at peace with it.

name: Snorkel Zombie
description: Walks underwater; invulnerable to most plants except when surfacing to eat.
flavor: Swims below the surface where almost nothing can touch him, and only comes up when it is time to bite.

name: Surfer Zombie
description: Rides a surfboard; moves very fast and crushes plants. After losing the board, becomes a normal zombie.
flavor: Rides his board straight over your lawn, flattening whatever is under it. Once he is off the board he is just a wet zombie.

name: Fisherman Zombie
description: Casts a fishing line to hook plants and pull them toward himself.
flavor: Casts a line, hooks a plant, and reels it away from your defences. Deeply unsporting and very good at it.

name: Octo Zombie
description: Throws octopi that disable plants.
flavor: Throws octopi that latch on and shut plants down completely. The octopi seem fine with the arrangement.

name: Beach Gargantuar
description: Beach Gargantuar; throws a beach Imp.
flavor: A Gargantuar in board shorts wielding an anchor. Neither the tide nor your lawn slows him down.

name: Beach Imp
description: Imp thrown by beach Gargantuar.
flavor: A tiny zombie in a mermaid tail, thrown over the water. He is having a better time than anyone else here.

name: Peasant Zombie
description: Basic Dark Ages zombie.
flavor: A medieval peasant with medieval hygiene. His life was hard before he died and has not improved much since.

name: Conehead Peasant
description: Conehead Dark Ages zombie.
flavor: A cone in the Dark Ages, which locals insist is a helmet. Nobody argues with a peasant holding a cone.

name: Buckethead Peasant
description: Buckethead Dark Ages zombie.
flavor: A bucket, or possibly a family heirloom. In this century the distinction hardly matters.

name: Knight Zombie
description: Wears shoulder armor and a crown; higher durability.
flavor: Proper plate armour and a crown to match. Takes a serious beating before anything gets through to the zombie inside.

name: Brickhead Peasant
description: Brickhead Dark Ages zombie.
flavor: Stonework on the head, mud on everything else. Extremely durable, extremely slow to reconsider.

name: Wizard Zombie
description: Casts a spell to transform plants into harmless sheep.
flavor: Casts a spell that turns your plants into sheep. The sheep are harmless, which is precisely the problem.

name: Jester Zombie
description: Catches and reflects many projectiles back at plants.
flavor: Catches your projectiles and throws them straight back. Years of practice and no other marketable skills.

name: Zombie King
description: Buffs nearby Dark Ages zombies (e.g., increases speed or damage).
flavor: Rules from the back of the lane and makes every zombie near him better at their job. Leadership, of a sort.

name: Dark Ages Gargantuar
description: Dark Ages Gargantuar; throws a Dark Ages Imp.
flavor: A Gargantuar in chainmail with a lamppost for a mace. The Dark Ages did not prepare anyone for this.

name: Dark Ages Imp
description: Imp thrown by Dark Ages Gargantuar.
flavor: A tiny zombie in a monk's habit, thrown with great enthusiasm and no particular aim.

name: Zomboss: Ancient Egypt
description: Zomboss of chapter Ancient Egypt  .
flavor: Dr. Zomboss in a scarab-plated war machine. He has waited four thousand years for this and intends to enjoy it.

name: Zomboss: Dark Ages
description: Zomboss of chapter Dark Ages.
flavor: Dr. Zomboss in a dragon mech that breathes actual fire. Subtlety was never the plan.

name: Zomboss: Frostbite Caves
description: Zomboss in his ice mech; freezes whole columns and drops snow blocks.
flavor: Dr. Zomboss in an ice mech, freezing whole columns at a time. He finds the cold invigorating and your defences disappointing.

name: Zomboss: Big Wave Beach
description: Zomboss in his shark mech; floods lanes and spits tidal blasts.
flavor: Dr. Zomboss in a shark mech, flooding lanes as he goes. He calls it a tidal strategy; everyone else calls it cheating.

name: Barrel Roller Zombie
description: Pushes a barrel ahead of him; the barrel crushes plants and keeps rolling if he dies before it breaks.
flavor: Pushes a barrel ahead of him and lets it do the flattening. Kill him early and the barrel keeps rolling regardless.

name: Imp Dragon Zombie
description: Small dragon-suited imp; flies over the lawn and resists fire.
flavor: A tiny zombie in a dragon suit who genuinely believes he can fly. He is not entirely wrong.

name: All-Star Zombie
description: Charges down the lane and tackles the first plant it reaches.
flavor: Charges down the lane and tackles the first plant he meets. He has been training for this since long before he died.

name: Turquoise Jane Zombie
description: Swings past obstacles on a vine and lands deeper in the lawn.
flavor: Swings past your front line on a vine and lands somewhere inconvenient. Style points awarded, none deserved.

name: Crystal Skull Zombie
description: Carries a crystal skull that shields it until the skull shatters.
flavor: Carries a crystal skull that soaks up damage until it shatters. He is quite attached to it, in every sense.

name: Prospector Zombie
description: Blasts himself to the far end of the lane, then walks back the other way.
flavor: Blasts himself to the far end of the lane with dynamite, then strolls back the wrong way. It works more often than it should.

name: Pianist Zombie
description: Plays a piano that shuffles nearby zombies between lanes every few seconds.
flavor: Plays a piano while his colleagues rearrange themselves between lanes. Nobody requested the music.

name: Newspaper Zombie
description: Reads while he walks; destroy the paper and he sprints in a rage.
flavor: Reads while he walks and takes it very badly when the paper is destroyed. The rage is real and so is the speed.

name: Arcade Zombie
description: Pushes an arcade cabinet that crushes whatever it touches.
flavor: Pushes an arcade cabinet that crushes anything in its path. He has not put a coin in it once.
